gloss: to inhale; to suck in; to absorb

definitions.explanation: To draw air or a gas into the lungs through the nose or mouth.

definitions.gloss: to suck in; to draw in
definitions.explanation: To pull something inward through suction, such as a vacuum cleaner drawing in dust or a drain drawing in water.
To take in and retain liquid or other substances, as a sponge absorbs water.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}く{息|いき}を{吸|す}い{込|こ}んでリラックスしてください。
examples.english: Please take a deep breath and relax.

examples.japanese: {掃除機|そうじき}がゴミを{吸|す}い{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The vacuum cleaner sucked up the dust.

examples.japanese: スポンジが{水|みず}を{吸|す}い{込|こ}んだ。

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{吸|す}い{込|こ}む → {吸|す}い{込|こ}まない (negative)
・{吸|す}い{込|こ}む → {吸|す}い{込|こ}んで (te-form)
・{吸|す}い{込|こ}む → {吸|す}い{込|こ}んだ (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {吸|す}う (to inhale, suck) + {込|こ}む (into)

The ～{込|こ}む pattern indicates drawing something inward.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{空気|くうき}を{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to inhale air
・{煙|けむり}を{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to inhale smoke
・ほこりを{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to suck in dust
・{水分|すいぶん}を{吸|す}い{込|こ}む - to absorb moisture

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. Takes を for the thing being inhaled or absorbed.
